svg.title: Training is a search, judged behind a wall
svg.desc: A small feature table whose price column is separated in green feeds a dashed cloud of candidate lines through six scatter points; three candidates are dashed red with crosses and one is solid green, while on the right a dashed padlocked wall separates train and validation blocks from a locked twenty-percent test block, an arrow from test back to the cloud is struck out and labelled peeking, and two bars compare a baseline mean absolute error of 0.906 with the model's 0.533.
svg.text: Training is a search, judged behind a wall
the dashed row is the one you must
you get ONE look at the
end. That is the whole of
41% less typical error - that gap is the whole job
...and does any of it hold on rows nobody has seen?
